title: The Athletic takes a close look at the events that led to Terrion Arnold's arrest

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: The Athletic takes a close look at the events that led to Terrion Arnold's arrest
sources.description: As cornerback Terrion Arnold waits for a new team to sign him — and for a judge to decide whether he'll be required to wear a GPS monitor while on house arrest pending trial — it's worth taking a look at how he landed in his current legal predicament.
